description:
The deployment guide's backup procedure accounts for the data root's scratch directory, so a backup carries no pending redo record.

## Background

The guide tells the reader to archive the whole data root and restore it elsewhere. Under the redo record that captures a pending commit point: restoring it into a repository that never performed the mutation would apply the record at the next session open.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The backup procedure excludes the data root's scratch directory.
- [hard] REQ-02: The restore procedure states that a restored data root carries no pending record.
- [hard] REQ-03: The guide states why the scratch directory is excluded, in one sentence.
- [hard] REQ-04: The guide carries no description of journaled publication.
title: Deployment guide backup procedure
